scope: Additive head-side chronology, immutable serving and synthetic engineering only. No market capture, market fitting, scientific decision, independent confirmation or upstream model refit.

inherits.rule: Change no numerical model, target formula/unit, optimizer, market fitting budget or scientific threshold. Existing evaluated numerical libraries, historical utility diagnostic, policies and receipts remain unchanged.

stages.order: Encoder fit <= joint online/target/Dynamics and direct-control fit < risk-TRAIN begin <= risk-TRAIN end <= head fit < evaluation begin <= evaluation end <= scoring maturity cutoff.
stages.strictOrigins: Every feature producer fit must strictly precede every risk-TRAIN origin endpoint. Head fitting must strictly precede every issued evaluation origin endpoint. Equality is unavailable and a delayed decision never legalizes a late fit.
stages.support: Require the complete declared past input envelope inside the corresponding head TRAIN or evaluation interval. Fit labels only when their full future support is inside head TRAIN and available_ms <= head fit cutoff. Retain exclusions and original origin identities.
stages.headRoles: Head TRAIN/evaluation roles are a separate ledger over original captured origins; never rewrite upstream timeline roles, capture identities or the representation fitting population.
stages.marketReference: The existing card declares representation/control fit at January23 2024 end UTC, later head TRAIN January24-25 with head fit January25 end, and development evaluation January26-28. These are future market constraints, not admission to run this study or open TEST.

features.sources: Authenticate issued forecast publication pins and exact source/capture/pair identities under the frozen upstream contract. Derive online-state/native-embedding histories from the same checked tuple and past windows. Direct-embedding forecasts must come from an exact checked fitted control and its comparison/output pins.
features.forbidden: Never accept state-bank fitting_forecasts, recompute retrospective direct-control fits, substitute same-width coordinates, refit upstream models or pool independently fitted state/target coordinate vectors.
features.engineeringPanel: Exercise current and K4 native embeddings, current and K4 online states, K4 embeddings plus an explicitly identified checked direct-embedding forecast, K4 embeddings plus issued target-state forecasts, and K4 online states plus issued target-state forecasts. A fixture may use the registered residual-MLP as its direct producer; ridge and MLP remain distinct producers.
features.campaignLimits: This timing milestone does not close the complete registered market panel: separate ridge and MLP forecast arms plus conventional, capacity and placebo controls remain mandatory under their own gates. A synthetic panel is no market comparison or substitute for those requirements.
features.commonPopulation: Use one exact common eligible input intersection for every compared arm and one mature label intersection per observable, with equal origin weights. Publish selected/excluded counts and reasons; never silently compress invalid rows or choose favorable arm-specific populations.

fitting.boundary: Select head-TRAIN metadata and copy only eligible mature TRAIN values into a TRAIN-only numerical fitting view before invoking the existing readout implementation. Evaluation values, masks, availability and features must not enter fit-time numerical validation, normalizers or parameter fitting. Immature/excluded label values are not copied into fitting arrays.
fitting.recipe: Reuse the unchanged TRAIN-normalized per-observable affine ridge library: ridge penalty1 and scale floor1e-8. Freeze fitted input means/scales, target means/scales, weights, units and exact feature identities.
fitting.insufficientSupport: Preserve explicit exclusion reasons and unfitted observable status; refuse to publish an admitted fitted stage when no observable has sufficient mature common TRAIN support. This supplies no market minimum-support admission.

serving.inputs: Prediction accepts only authenticated origin/feature data and privately owned frozen heads. Future observable values, masks, eligibility and maturity metadata cannot determine issued predictions.
serving.retention: Retain every requested origin/observable/arm association with explicit unavailable reasons and finite zero invalid storage. Keep target eligibility and maturity separate for scoring.
serving.coordinates: Bind one head to one exact upstream contract, four-component BundleRef, native/online/target coordinate identities, issued-publication pins and checked direct-control identity. Reject mixed folds and re-fitted coordinate substitutions. Cross-fitting requires a separate prospective policy with compatible per-fold heads and aggregation of common-observable metrics.

publication.manifest: Use a new version-owned head manifest; do not extend the evaluated generic sidecar roles. Bind policy/source identities, frozen upstream/control pins, stage bounds, original associations, target definitions/units, selected TRAIN-label identity, recipe and exact saved head/prediction/ledger bytes.
publication.consumption: Deserialize the same authenticated bytes, validate metadata and state, and expose no mutable aliases into privately owned head tensors. Reject changed archives, manifests, outputs, parents, stages and coordinates before serving.
publication.historical: Preserve old utility_main and its retrospective diagnostic semantics. A new dated synthetic receipt establishes only this staged path, not selected-Encoder capture, actual market utility or full campaign closure.

witnesses: Distinct upstream fit, issued risk-TRAIN, head fit and later evaluation stages
Strict origin cutoffs including equality and late decisions
Maturity exactly at cutoff accepted; later and stage-crossing labels excluded without reading their values
Evaluation and excluded-label perturbations leave fitted parameters and transforms unchanged
Future labels/masks/maturity cannot alter label-free inference
Retrospective, wrong-control, wrong-parent, wrong-origin and same-width incompatible-coordinate rejection
Common per-observable populations and retained invalid associations
Private immutable head state and exact checked archive/output roundtrip/corruption rejection
No Encoder execution or upstream update during head fitting and serving
